content_units: Cork Family Doctor Shortlist for Same-Week Parent + Child Visit

For a   non-urgent same-week appointment   with your priorities in order —   weekday evening hours, reasonable price, then public transit access   —   Riverbank Medical   is the strongest overall fit, with   Lee View Clinic   close behind if you want a better combined price and simpler rail access.
Ranked Clinic Comparison
Rank   Clinic   Hours   Parent + Child Cost   Transit Access   Pediatric Care   Best For
1   Riverbank Medical   Mon-Thu 09:00-20:00; Fri 09:00-17:00     €120     22 min by bus from city centre   Yes   Best evening availability
2   Lee View Clinic   Mon-Fri 08:30-18:30     €90     12 min walk from Kent Station   Yes   Best value with decent late slots
3   South Mall Practice   Mon-Fri 08:00-17:00     €88     6 min walk from city centre   Limited   Best central access, but weakest fit
Option 1:   Riverbank Medical     Best match for evening appointments; highest price but strongest weekday flexibility     Open until 20:00 Mon-Thu
- Pros:
- Best chance of getting a   same-week after-work appointment
- Pediatric care available
- Good if the parent needs to attend after standard office hours
- Cons:
- Highest total price for parent + child
- Less convenient transit than the others
- Friday loses the evening advantage
Option 2:   Lee View Clinic     Best balance of price, child care, and access; slightly weaker evening coverage than Riverbank     €90 total
- Pros:
- Strong value for a parent + child visit
- Pediatric care available
- Easy access if arriving via   Kent Station
- Open to   18:30  , which still helps for early evening scheduling
- Cons:
- Not as late as Riverbank for true evening appointments
- Slightly less central than South Mall
Option 3:   South Mall Practice     Cheapest adult fee and most central walk-in access, but not ideal for your stated priorities     No evening slots
- Pros:
- Very convenient central location
- Lowest adult consultation fee
- Lowest total cost by a small margin versus Lee View
- Cons:
-   No evening hours
- Pediatric care is   limited
- Weakest fit for a parent-and-child same-week appointment
Best Pick for Your Priorities
Recommended: Riverbank Medical
Why it ranks first:
- Your top priority is   weekday evening hours
- It is the   only option open until 20:00   on multiple weekdays
- It supports   pediatric care  , so it works better for a combined parent-and-child visit
Best value alternative: Lee View Clinic
- Choose this if you want the best overall balance of:
- lower combined cost
- pediatric availability
- solid transit convenience
- some early-evening availability
Not recommended as first choice: South Mall Practice
- Despite the central location and low price, it misses your top priority and has limited pediatric support.
Quick Actions
Choose Riverbank
Choose Lee View
Decision Notes
Context used:
- Parent + child total assumed as   one adult consultation plus one child consultation
- “Reasonable price” was weighted after evening access, per your stated priority order
- Public transit convenience was judged from the access details you provided rather than live route timing
